title: Search common surfaces before opening storage containers
description: Use this when looking for small portable objects such as watches, keys, or phones.
content: When searching for small objects, first check open surfaces like tables and countertops, because they often hold the target items directly. Only after checking visible surfaces should you open drawers or other closed storage.

title: Transport items one at a time when moving multiple objects
description: Use this when a task requires moving two or more objects to the same destination.
content: If you need to move multiple objects to one location, pick up one object, carry it to the destination, place it there, and then return for the next object. This avoids trying to carry multiple items at once and keeps the destination state easy to verify.

title: Reuse the same destination container for identical target objects
description: Use this when placing multiple objects of the same type into a target location.
content: When the task asks to put multiple similar objects somewhere, place all of them into the same target container or surface. After placing the first object, return to the source, retrieve the next object, and place it in that same destination.

title: Search systematically for target objects in storage furniture
description: Use when a required object is not immediately visible and must be located in the environment.
content: When searching for an object, systematically check all plausible storage locations such as cabinets, drawers, and shelves by opening each one. Do not stop after checking only a few locations; continue until the target object is found.

title: Cool items by using a fridge after retrieving them
description: Use when a task requires cooling an object before placing it somewhere.
content: First locate and take the object to be cooled, then go to a fridge and use the cool action with that object. The fridge does not need to be closed for the cooling action to work.

title: Place items on the destination surface after processing
description: Use when a task requires moving an object to a specific location after an intermediate action.
content: After performing the required intermediate action such as cooling, navigate to the destination surface and use the move or put action to place the object there.
